text:
sam: heads up — onboarding sample app surfaced a raw 500 when the model couldn't allocate memory. demo blocked, and the UX shows only 'Internal Server Error'.
alana: ugh. can you paste the exact payload/response you saw?
sam: sure — repro is calling /v1/generate with a ~200k-char prompt. response body was basically terse:
```
{"error":"internal_server_error","status":500,"message":"model execution failed"}
```
sam: that makes it impossible for the app to decide if it should retry, shrink the prompt, or fall back.
dinesh: agreed — we should surface a typed exception from the SDK (not just raw 500). propose mapping to a ModelOverloaded / CapacityError type with a retry hint and optional retry_after.
leo: parity across SDKs is critical. python/js/go should expose the same fields: .type / .code / .retry_after_ms / .is_retriable. onboarding samples need to show catch blocks.
alana: +1. also need clear mapping rules in docs: 429 -> RateLimit with retry_after, 503 -> ModelOverload (retriable short), 500 -> NonActionableInternal (non-retriable by default). we currently map too many to a generic exception.
sam: here's a suggestion for the error shape we return in hosted API and that SDKs convert into typed exceptions:
```
{
  "type":"ModelOverload",
  "code":503,
  "message":"gpu memory pressure: could not allocate KV cache",
  "retry_after_ms":1200,
  "hint":"try shorter input or use dedicated/reserved capacity"
}
```
alana: nice. SDKs could create classes: RedwoodError -> ModelOverload(RedwoodError) with attributes .retry_after_ms and .hint. example (python):
```
try:
    client.generate(...)
except ModelOverload as e:
    wait = e.retry_after_ms/1000 if e.retry_after_ms else 2
    time.sleep(wait)
    retry()
```
dinesh: for JS we should also expose an isRetriable boolean to make backoff libraries play nicely. and for Go have typed error interfaces so callers can switch on errors.IsModelOverload(err).
leo: telemetry: tag the request with error.type so we can build dashboards for top failure classes (rate-limit vs model-overload vs incorrect-params). this helps product triage and docs.
deploy-bot: deployment annotated: sample-app hotfix branch created by sam — build queued :rocket:
sam: I'll open two tiny PRs: (1) SDK exception mapping (python/js/go) that converts HTTP body -> typed exception with retry fields, (2) onboarding sample app: catch ModelOverload and show UI hint + suggested shorter prompt. @alana can you add the mapping table to the devex docs? I'll link the PRs here when ready.
alana: on it. I'll also add a short note about streaming errors: they should deliver a final structured error event on the stream so clients can surface the same hints.
leo: quick note — ensure we don't leak internal stack traces in messages. the public message field must be user-friendly and safe.
sam: yep. will sanitize. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
